settings.title: Settings
settings.reconnect: Device and server changes apply on the next connect.
settings.stationVox: Key the rig on incoming audio (VOX)
settings.muteHome: Mute my channel while listening in
settings.hotkeyHint: Use a modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) or a function key.
settings.otrspPort: OTRSP serial port (logger on this computer)
settings.otrspHelp: Set this only on the computer where the logger runs; the other position follows over the server (stereo servers only). TX1/TX2 select the transmitting radio, RX1/RX2 the radio heard, stereo receive selects both. Use a virtual serial port pair (for example com0com) between the logger and this program.
settings.roleOperatorHint: You hear radio 1 on the left and radio 2 on the right; choose radio 1, radio 2 or both. Your voice is sent to the radio selected at the station.
settings.roleStationHint: Send radio 1 as left and radio 2 as right. The operator's voice and PTT go to the transmitting radio only.
settings.singleDevice: Both radios on one stereo sound card (radio 1 left, radio 2 right)
settings.station2Hint: Radio 2 can share radio 1's port on the other line (for example RTS for radio 1, DTR for radio 2). Timing settings are shared with radio 1.

routing.title: Two radios
routing.otrspHint: No logger is sending OTRSP: choose a port in Settings, or let the other position's logger drive it
